title: Stable Pin Registry and Variant Verification for Quantized Models
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: We onboard many quantized variants (INT8/GPTQ/AWQ/FP8) for the same base model. Without a canonical, auditable registry and an automated variant verification workflow, operator teams manually pin versions, increasing risk of regressions and inconsistent rollouts. Goal: Implement a Stable Pin Registry service and an automated Variant Verification Harness that together enable: 1) immutable pins for production routes, 2) automated perf/quality verification for each quant artifact, 3) publishable provenance metadata for consumers and console UI, and 4) SLO-guarded canary rollouts with automatic safe-fallbacks. This ticket covers the design and MVP implementation of the registry, the verification CI job, telemetry contracts, and the console hooks for pin management.
acceptance_criteria: A Stable Pin Registry API exists that stores artifact pins (model_id, variant_id, quantization_type, commit_hash, artifacts_url, checksum, semantic_tags)
Variant Verification Harness runs automatically on artifact publish and emits a verification report with latency/cost/accuracy deltas vs pinned baseline
Canary rollout pipeline reads pins from the registry and enforces a delta-SLO (latency p95 and semantic-quality drop) before promoting pins to routes
Console shows pin metadata and last verification status; ops can create manual overrides with audit trail
Telemetry: published metrics include 'variant.verify.duration', 'variant.verify.delta_accuracy', 'variant.verify.delta_latency_p95', and a binary 'variant.verify.status' with reason codes
Safe fallback: if verification fails or SLO breach during canary, routing automatically falls back to the prior stable pin and an incident event is emitted

Integrate verification job into artifact publish pipeline and CI (GitHub Actions)

Console: add pin management UI and last-verification panel
Docs/Playbook: publish runbook for rollback & manual pinning

decisions: Use registry-backed immutable pins (uuid) rather than mutable tags to avoid silent roll-forward behavior
Verification harness will run both microbench perf runs (latency/cost) and a focused semantic test-set to detect meaning regressions
Delta-SLO thresholds: p95 latency <= +15% of baseline and semantic-quality drop <= 2% absolute; thresholds configurable per-customer route
Store full provenance (build id, base model id, quant config, compiler flags) in registry for traceability
risks: Verification false-positives for edge-case prompt sets cause unnecessary pin rejections
Large variance in perf measurements on shared infra could mask regressions; mitigation: run verifier on isolated smallest-cpu/GPU instance and use multiple runs
Console UX complexity: presenting provenance and verification history may overwhelm operators; product to design simplified view + advanced details
metrics: Percent of published variants that pass verification on first try >= 85%
Mean time to rollback when canary fails < 10m
Reduction in post-deploy perf regressions tied to quant artifacts (tracked via regression alerts) by 60% in first quarter
